summary: After several stop/start cycles and repeated remote disconnects during multi-channel renewal bursts, a controlled recovery was performed: stop/start rebuilt the agent; only the D02 binding was renewed (v3->v4) and one channel connected; a seed file was written and read back through the product fs RPC; the agent stayed connected.

finding.summary: Repeated bursts of 5 sequential SSH/helper channel renewals were followed by Coder agent disconnects (helper-stdout-ended), while one controlled single-channel renew/connect/seed kept the agent connected and responsive. This suggests SSH-session/agent capacity or burst sensitivity in the frozen lab; it is a correlation, not a proven root cause.

state.otherBindings: D05/D06/D07 and the second D02 binding remain invalid v3 due the latest generation change; renew one at a time before reconnecting.

next: Renew/connect remaining bindings one at a time with spacing; avoid multi-channel bursts.
Resume remote T-203/T-204/T-205 acceptance on the D02 v4 channel (read-only/limited) while watching agent stability.
